esikler.enlem_kaynak: Golombek et al. 2012 (MSL); Mars 2020 landing constraints

kaynaklar_en.yukseklik: MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 pixels/degree (megt90n000eb), PDS Geosciences Node; Smith et al. 2001, JGR 106, 23689
kaynaklar_en.termal_atalet: TES nighttime thermal inertia, Putzig and Mellon 2007 (Icarus 191, 68), via ASU JMARS map server, resampled to 0.1 deg
kaynaklar_en.albedo: MGS TES bolometric albedo 7410 m, USGS Astrogeology (Christensen et al. 2001)
kaynaklar_en.toz_olcutu: Thermal inertia < 100 and albedo > 0.25 considered thick dust, not suitable (MSL Landing Site Engineering User's Guide v2)

guven_notu_en: Global screening at ~6 km cells only: shows where landing is clearly ruled out by altitude, latitude or thick dust. It cannot judge slopes or rocks; those need local CTX/HiRISE data, which is why the detailed study area is Jezero.
